curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: appreciate the importance of writing fluency in lifelong learning.

mission.title: appreciate the importance of writing fluency in lifelong learning.

interactions.prompt: Which skill helps you share an idea on paper?
interactions.feedback: Yes! Writing lets us share ideas that others can read.
interactions.retryHint: Think about making words with a pencil.

interactions.prompt: Why does Asha practise writing short sentences?
choices: To write more smoothly and clearly.
interactions.answer: To write more smoothly and clearly.
interactions.retryHint: Think about what improves when we practise a skill.

interactions.prompt: Sort the habits that build fluent writing.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a habit, then tap its group.
interactions.feedback: Great! Regular, careful practice grows fluent writing.
interactions.retryHint: Choose habits that give you chances to make words and sentences.

interactions.prompt: Which task uses fluent writing in everyday life?
interactions.feedback: Well done! Clear notes help us communicate.
interactions.retryHint: Look for the task that puts a message on paper.

interactions.prompt: Match each writing task to its purpose.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a writing task, then tap why it is useful.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! Fluent writing supports many parts of life.
interactions.retryHint: Ask what each piece of writing helps a person do.

interactions.prompt: Why is writing fluency important for lifelong learning?
choices: It helps us record and share what we learn.
interactions.answer: It helps us record and share what we learn.
interactions.feedback: Exactly! Fluent writing helps learning now and in the future.
interactions.retryHint: Think about how written words keep and communicate ideas.
